decision_notes: Focused RNA, ATAC, and WNN subclustering of global clusters 11 and 17 identified a stable 42-nucleus child derived entirely from global cluster 11. The child was unchanged across resolutions 0.1 through 0.8, contained nuclei from both diets, captured 39 of 46 strict tuft-program-positive nuclei, and had 92.9% strict tuft-program purity. Resolution 0.5 was selected as the highest reviewed four-cluster solution before resolution 0.6 subdivided the enteroendocrine branch. The 42-nucleus child is approved as immune-like tuft. The resolution-0.6 enteroendocrine subdivision is retained as exploratory and is not used for the primary cell-state annotation.
